name: hauntedhush
does: A haunted breakdown as it was (old): 8 bars, 4 quiet and then its drum & bass drop, to A/B against the 12 bars with 8 quiet (the default). Sets tuning music.hauntedHush to 4.
decision: The quiet stretch before a haunted breakdown's drop is 8 bars (Ed, 2026-11-16: "Make it 8 bars"); the 4-bar hush kept to A/B
